name: canvas
title: Canvas
description: A tldraw whiteboard persisted as one .tldraw JSON file through @boring/files: saves at the revision it read, conflict banner on a stale save. Tools: canvas_get_shapes, canvas_select, canvas_create_shapes, canvas_update_shapes (bound to the canvas version read).
docs: tldraw needs a licence key in production (https://tldraw.dev/pricing): pass licenseKey from your application's config at runtime, e.g. TLDRAW_LICENSE_KEY served to the page. Development on localhost needs none. Needs @boring/viewers and @boring/files in your package.json.
